purpose: Re-measure dp4a on the CURRENT GPU-bound block verify (prior dp4a perf was on the old serial route), and give a bottom-up rocprof kernel-family breakdown of the 38 ms verify GPU time to prove there is no remaining exact-precision lever.

dp4a_block_verify_wall_ms.method: verify_target_block(rows=4,bulk), per-block wall avg over N=24, scratchpad/dp4a_blockverify_wall.py
dp4a_block_verify_wall_ms.finding: dp4a cuts the block-verify wall by only ~4% (all flags), NOT the -35% the 2026-06-28 isolated-kernel measurement implied. q8_1 quantize launches offset the per-GEMV savings and the MoE it targets is only ~26% of verify GPU. dp4a is doubly refuted on the current path: ~4% perf AND ja top-1 0.700 < 0.90 gate.

verify_gpu_kernel_breakdown_pct.method: rocprofv3 --kernel-trace DurationNs sum by kernel family, block verify run

accelerability.attention_q8_0_projections: NOT accelerable: blockIdx.y=row (per-row), but weights ~4 MB fit the 32 MB MALL/L2 (L2-served, unlike the 417 MB lm-head) and q8_0 dequant is one multiply (vs Q6_K 6-bit unpack the rowtile saved). The 33% is genuine per-row compute over 4 DISTINCT tokens' activations - no cross-row amortization. WMMA underutilized at 4<16 rows (de-risked neutral at verify sizes).
accelerability.gdn_recurrent_state: NOT accelerable: f32 recurrent SSM state, precision-critical, un-quantizable.
accelerability.moe_selected_experts: dp4a-targetable but nets only ~4% wall and fails ja gate.
accelerability.lm_head: ALREADY rowtile-amortized (the only shared-weight opportunity: all rows read the same head).
accelerability.conclusion: Bottom-up: every component of the 38 ms verify is already-optimized, un-quantizable, or dp4a-gated. The block verify is at its exact-precision GPU-compute floor.

standing.note: Beats llama on AR (54.6 vs 50.1) and on the ja correctness gate. Parity needs dp4a (fails gate) - not an effort-gated lever.
